report.headline: Brightwash Liquid Detergent 1L goes out of stock at Delhi DC on 20 August due to unreflected demand surge.
report.narrative: Root cause stems from demand planning, where actual demand exceeded forecast by 17.7% over the last four weeks. A visible warning sign appeared 14 days before the stockout, highlighting the forecast gap.

causes.cause: Recent demand surge not reflected in the forecast
causes.action: Re-baseline the Brightwash Liquid Detergent 1L forecast at Delhi DC: demand has run 18% above forecast over the last 4 weeks (visible from 6 Aug). Add the surge to the next planning cycle.

ruled_out.why: 99.4% vs threshold below 95%: within normal range

provenance.sql:
SELECT 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN delivery_date <= required_delivery_date
                      THEN COALESCE(accepted_qty, 0) ELSE 0 END)
       / NULLIF(SUM(ordered_qty), 0) AS value,
       COUNT(*) AS orders_in_window, SUM(ordered_qty) AS ordered_qty
FROM scm_orders.replenishment_orders
WHERE sku_id = '200118' AND dc_id = 'DC2'
  AND required_delivery_date BETWEEN date_sub(DATE '2026-08-20', 84) AND date_sub(DATE '2026-08-20', 1)

SELECT 1.0 * (SUM(actual_demand_qty) - SUM(forecast_qty))
       / NULLIF(SUM(actual_demand_qty), 0) AS value,
       SUM(actual_demand_qty) AS actual_demand_qty, SUM(forecast_qty) AS forecast_qty
FROM scm_planning_01.demand_daily
WHERE sku_id = '200118' AND dc_id = 'DC2' AND demand_date BETWEEN date_sub(DATE '2026-08-20', 84) AND date_sub(DATE '2026-08-20', 1)

SELECT 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.days_on_hand < n.safety_stock_days THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.days_on_hand < n.safety_stock_days THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS breach_days,
       COUNT(*) AS days_observed, MAX(n.safety_stock_days) AS safety_stock_days
FROM scm_wms.inventory_snapshots s
JOIN scm_wms.inventory_norms n ON s.sku_id = n.sku_id AND s.dc_id = n.dc_id
WHERE s.sku_id = '200118' AND s.dc_id = 'DC2' AND s.snapshot_date BETWEEN date_sub(DATE '2026-08-20', 84) AND date_sub(DATE '2026-08-20', 1)

WITH actual AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ordered_qty), 0) AS qty
  FROM scm_orders.replenishment_orders
  WHERE sku_id = '200118' AND dc_id = 'DC2' AND required_delivery_date BETWEEN date_sub(DATE '2026-08-20', 84) AND date_sub(DATE '2026-08-20', 1)),
inv_d1 AS (
  SELECT on_hand_qty FROM scm_wms.inventory_snapshots
  WHERE sku_id = '200118' AND dc_id = 'DC2'
    AND snapshot_date = date_sub(DATE '2026-08-20', 84 + 1)),
design_d AS (
  SELECT s.fwd_avg_daily_forecast * n.inventory_norm_days AS qty
  FROM scm_wms.inventory_snapshots s
  JOIN scm_wms.inventory_norms n ON s.sku_id = n.sku_id AND s.dc_id = n.dc_id
  WHERE s.sku_id = '200118' AND s.dc_id = 'DC2'
    AND s.snapshot_date = date_sub(DATE '2026-08-20', 1)),
fc AS (
  SELECT SUM(forecast_qty) AS qty FROM scm_planning_01.demand_daily
  WHERE sku_id = '200118' AND dc_id = 'DC2' AND demand_date BETWEEN date_sub(DATE '2026-08-20', 84) AND date_sub(DATE '2026-08-20', 1))
SELECT 1 - 1.0 * a.qty / NULLIF(GREATEST(0, dd.qty - i.on_hand_qty + f.qty), 0) AS value,
       a.qty AS actual_ordered_qty,
       GREATEST(0, dd.qty - i.on_hand_qty + f.qty) AS theoretical_order_qty
FROM actual a CROSS JOIN inv_d1 i CROSS JOIN design_d dd CROSS JOIN fc f

SELECT 1.0 * (SUM(actual_demand_qty) - SUM(forecast_qty))
       / NULLIF(SUM(actual_demand_qty), 0) AS value,
       SUM(actual_demand_qty) AS actual_demand_qty, SUM(forecast_qty) AS forecast_qty
FROM scm_planning_01.demand_daily
WHERE sku_id = '200118' AND dc_id = 'DC2'
  AND demand_date BETWEEN date_sub(DATE '2026-08-20', 28) AND date_sub(DATE '2026-08-20', 1)

SELECT AVG(1.0 * GREATEST(0, datediff(LEAST(COALESCE(delivery_date, DATE '2026-08-20'), DATE '2026-08-20'),
                                      dispatch_date) - std_lead_time_days)
           / std_lead_time_days) AS value,
       AVG(1.0 * datediff(LEAST(COALESCE(delivery_date, DATE '2026-08-20'), DATE '2026-08-20'),
                          dispatch_date)) AS avg_actual_lead_time_days,
       MAX(std_lead_time_days) AS std_lead_time_days,
       SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(delivery_date, DATE '2026-08-20') > required_delivery_date
                THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_or_overdue_orders
FROM scm_orders.replenishment_orders
WHERE sku_id = '200118' AND dc_id = 'DC2'
  AND required_delivery_date BETWEEN date_sub(DATE '2026-08-20', 84) AND date_sub(DATE '2026-08-20', 1)

SELECT demand_date, forecast_qty, actual_demand_qty
FROM scm_planning_01.demand_daily
WHERE sku_id = '200118' AND dc_id = 'DC2'
  AND demand_date BETWEEN date_sub(DATE '2026-08-20', 28) AND date_sub(DATE '2026-08-20', 1)
ORDER BY demand_date

SELECT SUM(actual_demand_qty - fulfilled_qty) AS lost_units,
       SUM(CASE WHEN actual_demand_qty > fulfilled_qty THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS short_days
FROM scm_planning_01.demand_daily
WHERE sku_id = '200118' AND dc_id = 'DC2' AND demand_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-20' AND date_sub(DATE '2026-08-20', -27)
